visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair in a high ponytail, wearing a beige oversized sweatshirt over a red inner garment, is seen running outdoors. She has an intense facial expression with her mouth wide open as if panting heavily while looking directly at the camera. The background consists of lush green trees and a blurry urban street setting with natural daylight. (2) The camera cuts to a large-framed man with a beard, wearing a black and purple basketball jersey with the word 'CONQUERORS' on it. He is running forward with a strained, squinting facial expression. The background shows more greenery, indicating a park or a running path. (3) The scene returns to the woman, who now looks distressed and fatigued. She reaches out her right hand toward the camera as if trying to grab something or slow down, her face showing signs of exhaustion and struggle. (4) A brief montage shows the woman in different outfits: first in a green and black cheerleader uniform dancing in a stadium, then on a stage with vibrant pink and blue spotlighting, and finally in a park holding up a pair of white high-waisted shorts/underwear. The lighting shifts from natural to artificial stage lights. (5) Back at the race, the woman looks determined. A colorful, animated logo for '滿貫大亨' (Grand Slams Tycoon) pops up in the center of the frame. She points a finger at the camera with a confident, smiling expression. (6) The man in the basketball jersey is seen from behind running on a blue athletic track, then he suddenly looks back with a shocked expression before falling onto the blue surface, clutching his leg. (7) The woman, now wearing a red sleeveless polo top and a white pleated miniskirt, performs a choreographed dance routine on the blue track. She smiles and makes energetic hand gestures. Two men appear in the background, one blowing a red horn and both cheering enthusiastically. (8) The woman runs across a pink finish line tape, celebrating with raised arms and a wide smile. The man remains lying on the track in the background. The video ends with a promotional call-to-action as the woman points to the camera while the logo reappears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic female voice speaking rapidly, mimicking a sports commentator's urgent tone. A fast-paced electronic BGM with a strong, driving beat (approx. 130 BPM) plays at a moderate volume. The environment sounds like a clean field recording with minimal ambient floor. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effect occurs as the scene cuts. The female voice shifts to a more personal, breathless internal monologue style, exhibiting audible panting and a lower, more fatigued pitch variability. (3) A loud, synthesized 'ding' or impact sound effect accompanies the appearance of the graphic logo. The BGM maintains its high tempo, providing a consistent energy layer throughout the narrative transition. (4) A male voice suddenly yells '什麼' (What?) with high arousal and a sharp pitch contour. This is followed immediately by a thud-like 'impact' sound effect as he falls. The BGM remains steady, but the vocal intensity peaks here. (5) The BGM transitions into a more melodic, pop-style jingle featuring a group of female singers performing a rhythmic chant. The beat becomes more pronounced. A loud, sharp 'honk' from a plastic horn SFX pierces through the mix, followed by a layer of synthesized cheering and applause SFX. (6) The primary female voice returns with a professional, persuasive tone, speaking clearly and enthusiastically about the mobile game. The BGM reaches a final peak in volume before a clean fade-out at the very end.

It starts with the creator losing a race to another athlete, then framing the mobile game as a tool for 'reversing life' (victory), leading into a branded jingle and dance to promote the app.
